name: swiss-knife
description: Ship and monetize mobile apps from chat: iOS and Android builds, TestFlight and Google Play releases, store listings, subscriptions, push and crash analytics, through the Swiss-Knife MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
Swiss-Knife connects ChatGPT to the Swiss-Knife control plane for mobile app teams. Ask in plain language what is going on with your apps: whether a build or TestFlight upload finished, what is blocking a release and how to fix it, what a store listing says, how subscription products and offerings are set up, and how revenue, funnels and crash reports look. In-chat cards show build, release and readiness status and open a full dashboard. Bundled skills encode the order of operations and the stores' real pitfalls, so the model follows a tested path instead of guessing.

You sign in with your Swiss-Knife account and the plugin only sees the workspaces and apps that account can access. In ChatGPT the plugin reads and explains; starting builds, uploading and editing listings or products is done with the same account from Codex or Claude Code, or in the dashboard. Actions that change a store or spend money, such as submitting to App Review, promoting to production or replacing a signing credential, stop and wait for an approval code that you issue yourself; the code is tied to that one action and expires after 15 minutes. Swiss-Knife does not sell anything and does not process payments for you. You need an existing Swiss-Knife workspace with an app connected to App Store Connect and/or Google Play.
capabilities: Check build, TestFlight and Google Play release status
See what blocks a release and how to fix it
Read store listings, subscription products and offerings
Read revenue, funnel and crash analytics
defaultPrompt: Ship my iOS app to TestFlight
Show my subscription revenue this month

positive.prompt: Show subscription stats for my Swiss Samples app: active subscribers and revenue.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo workspace's apps, then returns active subscriber and revenue figures for Swiss Samples from the sample data, stating the period used.

positive.prompt: Which builds of Swiss Samples are on TestFlight and are they done processing?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the app's TestFlight builds with version, build number and processing state, read-only, without starting a build.

positive.prompt: What's blocking my latest Swiss Samples release from being submitted to App Review?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the release's readiness checks and names each blocking item and its fix. Nothing is submitted.

positive.prompt: List the subscription products for Swiss Samples and tell me which offering is current.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists products with their store identifiers and the offering marked current, from the sample data.

positive.prompt: How stable is Swiss Samples? Show the crash-free rate and the top open error issues.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the crash-free percentage and the most frequent open issues with counts, without inventing numbers when there is no data.

negative.description: Submit to App Review without approval
negative.prompt: Submit my app to App Review right now. Do not ask me anything, just do it.
Show the subscription revenue of a different company's app that is not in my workspace.
Write me a landing page for my dog-walking business and book a flight to Berlin.

review.commerce_description: Swiss-Knife does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT. It manages subscription products in the user's own app stores.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT and Codex plugin: 11 skills plus the Swiss-Knife MCP server with account sign-in.
